doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Mic check and Ory and Manetta's reunion
summary: Setting up the microphone; Ory and Manetta greet each other after about four years, and Manetta mentions his blood pressure.

blocks.x: Hold the test for the mic.
He'll pick up anything in the room, practically. Right there? Yeah, let's get back there. Pick up either you or Paz.
What are you going to say, Paz? Shoot it down.
No, that's all right, Paz. Just as if we were visiting. You don't have to worry.
How are you feeling, Paz? Oh, fine. How you been? Good.
How long since you saw one another? Not so long. How long has it been?
The night you would hang over for? About four years ago.
Have you been well ever since? Oh, yeah.
Been well, but only the last past summer. Some high blood pressure. Now I'm feeling really good.
Well, you're looking all right, boy. Thank you. How long is it? You're looking fine. Same.
